note: Gogebic County's official parcel map is a Colligo GIS web viewer (colligogis.com). The county site links no parcel downloads or REST endpoints and directs data requests to the Equalization Office. Colligo's guide describes no public ArcGIS REST or GeoJSON parcel endpoint. ArcGIS Hub/Online and web searches found no Gogebic parcel FeatureServer or MapServer. Gogebic parcels are sold only by commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, USLandGrid, Acres).
